{{Icon|Electric Susceptibility icon|text=false|nolink=true}} [[Electric Susceptibility]] is a type of debuff inflicted to enemies in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

When enemies are inflicted with '''Electric Susceptibility''', they temporarily take more {{Color|Electric DMG|6}}. The number represents the degree of increase.

An enemy that is considered '''Arts Susceptible''' is also considered '''Electric Susceptible'''. For example, while {{Icon|Avywenna icon|[[Avywenna]]'s}} {{Color|Carrot and Sharp Stick|7}} only explicitly states that it is triggered from enemies that are {{G|Electric Susceptibility|Electric Susceptible}}, applying Arts Susceptibility to the target also triggers this Potential.

Multiple sources of Electric Susceptibility, as well as {{G|Arts Susceptibility}}, stack <u>additively</u> to form the '''Susceptibility Multiplier''' for that damage instance. The resulting Susceptibility Multiplier then stacks <u>multiplicatively</u> with other damage multipliers to get the final value. For more information on calculating damage, see [[Damage calculation]].
